body: Wave 1 at 19:30 on 2026-10-02.U+000AU+000AU+002D Lane 1 (phone-sheet) ok, committed as 792a0cdc on mitosis/proto-phone-shell. The commit holds only its seven files.U+000AU+002D Lane 2 (streak-pill, phone-shell-chrome, macos-sidebar) ended failed with exit 0 and "reported failed". All code is done. Two of its own acceptance test files had test-side bugs, and the receipts edit hook locked them after their first red run. Handoff: ~/.mitosis/field-notes/prototype-phone-macos/handoff/proto-phone-shell-lane-2.md.U+000A  U+002D I applied both fixes in the worktree (uncommitted) and verified them; dart format and flutter analyze are clean, and all 4 tests in the two files pass.U+000A   U+0020U+002D test/design/feedback/glass_toast_test.dart: `key: UniqueKey()` on the MaterialApp in `_show`. The second pumpWidget lerped the theme from Android, so the macOS toast was built at phone radius.U+000A   U+0020U+002D test/app/shell/sidebar_collapse_test.dart: the mid-animation width check became a check that the 'sidebar-rail' AnimatedContainer has duration 250 ms and curve Cubic(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1). Reduce motion, used to stop the petals, makes AnimationController run 20 times faster, so at 125 ms the resize was already finished.U+000AU+002D Plan for Lane 2: after the run exits, set lanes["2"].state to "held" (reason null) in ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-10-02-prototype-wave1/state.json, then run `run.zsh 1 --resume` detached. run.py `_land` commits only the Lane's write-set, and `_still_written` checks the writes are present. Lanes 3, 7, 8, 9 and 10 are blocked on Lane 2 and run after it.U+000AU+002D Existing tests that Lane 2's change breaks and that no wave 1 Step fixes. These need a separate, named fix-up commit on mitosis/proto-phone-shell after wave 1 and before the full suite. They must not be left uncommitted in the worktree before the resume, or they would be swept into a Lane commit.U+000A  U+002D test/design/design_kit_dark_test.dart 'dark toast and focus ring draw their dark colours' (lines ~156-165) asserts the old solid pill colour 0xFF3D3229 and ink 0xFFF6EAD6. The new check: the Toast holds a GlassSurface with tone GlassTone.toast, and its text is #fbf3e4.U+000A  U+002D test/app/shell/petal_layer_test.dart `_expectPetalsOnEveryPageButTheMeadow` (around line 344) asserts ShellContent is not the full surface. The phone body now fills the screen, so that check must apply to ShellLayout.sidebar only. Wave 2's petal-pace task updates this file "only where it counted the old narrow petals", so it does not cover this.U+000A  U+002D The test/accessibility shell_garden_fixes 48 dp gear and shell_sweep a8-garden-phone 'streak-card' failures are owned by shell-a11y (Lane 10).U+000AU+002D Lanes 4 (day-and-log-sheets) and 5 (phone-composer-fullscreen) are running. The watch is Monitor task bt389cgri.
